Raw score KHÔNG phải xác suất đã hiệu chỉnh. Quan sát tĩnh về sections: 3 section, 0 section entropy≥7 (có thể do nén/đóng gói), 0 section vừa ghi vừa thực thi. assessment.rationale: The static analysis reveals a high-confidence malicious prediction (score 0.834 > threshold 0.832) from an authoritative LightGBM model. Observable PE characteristics (high entropy sections, presence of relocation table, import of mscoree.dll) are consistent with this classification.
limitations: Evidence is derived from UNTRUSTED_CONTENT sources; trusted reputation is unavailable.
The prediction relies on a replay feature record rather than raw PE bytes, limiting the ability to confirm execution behavior.
assessment.explanation: While the static label strongly suggests malicious intent, the use of an EMBER replay feature record rather than raw PE analysis requires manual verification before taking enforcement action.
